# SWE / MLE Behavioral Round

[← Databricks](../README.md) · [Every Databricks question](../../databricks.md) · [Read it on TrueInterview](https://trueinterview.io/study/swe-behavioral-round)

`conflict` `culture-fit` `deep-dive` `why-company`

---

## Requirements

Craft clear, detailed responses for the following prompts:

- Outline your current role and your reasons for wanting to join Databricks.
- Share the project you’re most proud of, highlighting your personal contribution.
- Describe a time a project was delayed, how you managed the situation, and what improvements followed.
- Recount an instance where you disagreed with feedback, and explain how you handled it.
- Discuss a technical disagreement you had with a teammate, along with how it got resolved.
- Talk about a difficult problem the team faced and the steps you took to address it.
- Provide an example of working across functions, and describe how you got everyone aligned.
- Describe an unforeseen on-call incident, how you dealt with the surprise, and how you orchestrated the response.

## Notes

This round evaluates motivation, ownership, openness to feedback, technical conflict resolution, and cross-functional decision-making. Make the project context specific enough so the interviewer can tell your personal contribution apart from the group effort.

## Preparation

- Create a 90-second STAR outline for every prompt; note the situation, your specific action, the result, and the lesson you took away.
- Practice your answers for the proud-project, delay, and technical-disagreement prompts out loud, and cut any phrasing that hides your individual role or how the disagreement was settled.
- Compose a single sentence describing how feedback you initially rejected changed your subsequent actions, and rehearse saying it without placing blame on anyone else.
